name: Connectome Workbench vertex areas and metric statistics
purpose: Compute per-vertex surface area and print spatial statistics (reduction or percentile) on a metric file via Workbench Command.

inputs.statement: A surface file to measure for -surface-vertex-areas.
Optional ROI metric file restricting which data are considered.
inputs.quote: [-roi] - only consider data inside an roi

conditions.statement: Exactly one of -reduce or -percentile must be specified for -metric-stats.
conditions.quote:
Exactly one of
-reduce or -percentile must be specified.

conditions.statement: The percentile must be between 0 and 100.
The -reduce argument must be one of the listed operations (MAX, MIN, MEAN, MEDIAN, etc.).
conditions.quote: The argument to the -reduce option must be one of the following:

steps.statement: Run wb_command -surface-vertex-areas with the surface and output metric.
steps.quote:
wb_command -surface-vertex-areas
<surface> - the surface to measure
<metric> - output - the output metric

steps.statement: Assign each vertex one third of the area of each triangle it belongs to.
steps.quote: Each vertex gets one third of the area of each triangle it is a part of.

steps.statement: Run wb_command -metric-stats with the input metric and a reduction or percentile operation.
Optionally restrict analysis to an ROI metric file.
steps.quote:
[-roi] - only consider data inside an roi
<roi-metric> - the roi, as a metric file

steps.statement: Optionally match each input column to the corresponding ROI column.
steps.quote:
[-match-maps] - each column of input uses the corresponding column
from the roi file

outputs.statement: The vertex-areas output is a metric file.
Vertex areas are in units of mm^2.
For each input column, a line of text is printed from the specified reduction or percentile operation.
outputs.quote:
For each column of the input, a line of text is printed, resulting from
the specified reduction or percentile operation.

outputs.statement: With -roi and without -match-maps, each line contains as many numbers as there are maps in the ROI file, tab-separated.
outputs.quote:
each line will contain as many numbers as there are
maps in the ROI file, separated by tab characters.

parameters.statement: Reduction operation choice; the argument to -reduce must be one of the listed operations.
parameters.quote:
[-reduce] - use a reduction operation
<operation> - the reduction operation
<percent> - the percentile to find, must be between 0 and 100

parameters.statement: Optional single column selection by number or name.
parameters.quote:
[-column] - only display output for one column
<column> - the column number or name

parameters.statement: Optional flag to print map index and name before each output.
parameters.quote: [-show-map-name] - print map index and name before each output
